verdict.rationale: mParticle documents a server-side Events API for sending events directly. It publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec for the Event Server, and batches carry a documented environment field. The evidence does not show how requests are authenticated or what delivery guarantees apply, so only the core ingestion surface is established. Missing for 10: documented authentication scheme (keys/secrets), delivery guarantees (retries, acknowledgements, durability/idempotency), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can send events server-to-server through a documented HTTP ingestion API with authentication and delivery guarantees

citations.quote: Use the Open API (previously known as Swagger) specification or similar tools to generate helper SDKs (using Swagger Codegen or OpenAPI Generator) for the Events API
This is the mParticle Event Server
Every Events API batch carries an environment field
